The Town of Andover's official 2024 Town Officers list shows three elected Cemetery Commissioners; no official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current holders (the 2024 list is superseded for the other offices it names), so the post is created as structure only.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (moderator, elected annually). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Andover holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (auditors elected at annual meeting; three serve staggered three-year terms under section 2651. A town may vote to eliminate the office and engage a public accountant under section 2651b; whether this town has done so is not determinable from published sources). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Andover holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.
